hero.title: About Kingdom Deliverance Centre Uganda
hero.subtitle: Meet our church community in Kosovo–Lungujja, Kampala. Join us for worship, prayer and Bible teaching in English and Luganda.

leaders.bio: Bishop Climate Wiseman leads Kingdom Deliverance Centre Uganda and the Kingdom Temple ministry network.
leaders.name: Bishop Climate Wiseman Irungu
leaders.title: Senior Pastor & Founder

leaders.bio: Pastor Clear is part of the church leadership introduced by KDC Uganda alongside Bishop Climate Wiseman.
leaders.name: Pastor Clear
leaders.title: Co-Founder & Kingdom Temple UK

timeline.event: English worship: 8:00–10:30 AM EAT. Luganda worship: 10:30 AM–2:00 PM EAT.
Fire Service: the last Friday of each month, 6:00–9:30 PM EAT. Check Events for the actual date.
Meet at Kingdom Deliverance Centre, Kosovo Trading Centre, Lungujja, Kampala.

about.affiliationText: Kingdom Deliverance Centre Uganda is proudly affiliated with Kingdom Temple, a global ministry network founded and led by Bishop Climate Wiseman.

foundationCards.label: Our Mission
foundationCards.text: To share the Gospel of Jesus Christ through worship, prayer, biblical teaching and care for our community.

foundationCards.label: Our Vision
foundationCards.text: A church family growing in faith, learning from Scripture and supporting one another in daily life.

foundationCards.label: Our Values
foundationCards.text: Faith, prayer, integrity, love for others, community and a commitment to learning from the Bible.

missionHtml: Kingdom Deliverance Centre Uganda exists to set captives free through the power of the Gospel, vibrant worship, and Spirit-led teaching.
